premises.text: Local businesses leave spend on the table because a small share of customers drives half of revenue and existing punch-card and mobile loyalty tools are burdensome and not personalized
premises.evidence_span: 15% of their customers, people like me, represent about 50% of their revenue

premises.text: Cardify awards personalized VIP points and perks from ordinary credit-card swipes with no punch cards, check-ins, NFC, or phone at the register
premises.evidence_span: I get points at these local places by simply swiping my credit card

premises.text: Merchants can run tailored rewards, VIP access, competitions, and redemptions with zero software or hardware integration on existing POS
premises.evidence_span: there is zero software integration, zero hardware integration for the business

premises.text: Cardify gives merchants real-time in-store CRM: who is present, social profile signals, spend history, and bottom-line impact insights
premises.evidence_span: Cardify, in real time, will show Fig & Olive who is at their store right now

premises.text: Partnerships with Citigrid Media and Urban Spoon reach about half a million US merchants
